Risk Description: Agent is manipulated via external untrusted data (Indirect Prompt Injection) to execute unauthorized API actions
Mitigation: Enforce strict output schema validation, implement LLM firewalls, and require Human-in-the-Loop authorization for critical actions

Risk Description: Agent gets stuck in an infinite tool-execution loop or cascading API chain causing massive resource consumption
Mitigation: Set strict maximum token limits, enforce a hard cap on sequential execution steps (e.g. max 10 steps per run), and implement budget alerts

Risk Description: Agent has access to broad read/write database privileges it does not explicitly require to execute tasks
Mitigation: Enforce the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) on all API keys and service accounts assigned to the agent

Risk Description: Agent utilizes insecure user-built plugins that lack input validation allowing command injection
Mitigation: Enforce digital signing for approved plugins, run all plugin executions inside isolated sandboxes, and sanitize inputs
